title: Strong diffeomorphic approximation in three dimensions for 1≤p≤2
summary: We resolve the three-dimensional Ball–Evans approximation problem for $`1\le p\le2`$. Every $`W^{1,p}`$ homeomorphism between arbitrary bounded domains in ℝ 3 is a strong $`W^{1,p}`$ limit of smooth diffeomorphisms onto the same target.

review.reason: Resolves strong W^{1,p} diffeomorphic approximation of homeomorphisms in three dimensions for p in [1,2].
